plan.intro: Show a shape. Learners write down everything they can say about it in one minute.
main: Name the properties precisely and agree the vocabulary we will use.
Learners measure and construct accurately with ruler, protractor and compasses.
Learners find a rule by trying several cases, then test it on a new one.

plan.title: Reviewing statistics and probability
plan.unit: Unit 11: Reviewing Stage 6 and getting ready for lower secondary
plan.prior: Lesson 184: Fluency practice: Stage 6 review
plan.next: Lesson 186: Practise and apply: Stage 6 review (2)
plan.intro: Show a graph with no title or labels. What can we honestly say about it?
main: Agree the question the data has to answer before collecting or reading anything.
Learners construct the representation accurately, choosing a sensible scale.
Learners interpret it: what does it show, and what does it not show?
Discuss a misleading version of the same data and what makes it misleading.
plan.plenary: One conclusion each, with the part of the graph that supports it.
plan.look_for: Choosing a sensible scale, and conclusions the data can actually carry.

tasks.heading: 1. List the outcomes
tasks.instruction: List every possible outcome, systematically.

tasks.heading: 2. Write the probability
tasks.instruction: Write each probability as a fraction, a decimal and a percentage.

tasks.heading: 3. Run the experiment
tasks.instruction: Record your results. Do enough trials for a pattern to show.

tasks.heading: 4. Expected and actual
tasks.instruction: Were they the same? Why not? What would make them closer?
